content_sections.heading: NIT Jamshedpur Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 10 vacancies are available - 1 for Athletics, 1 for Badminton, 1 for Basketball, 1 for Chess, 1 for Cricket, 1 for Football, 1 for Hockey, 1 for Lawn Tennis, 1 for Table Tennis, and 1 for Volleyball.

content_sections.heading: NIT Jamshedpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Diploma or Certificate course in coaching from recognized University/Institute/Organization or Professional level of coaching course or participation at National level or State level or Inter College competition in their respective discipline.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Jamshedpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Guest Coach posts at NIT Jamshedpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Coach posts at NIT Jamshedpur is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Guest Coach position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for the Guest Coach position at NIT Jamshedpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Coach role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Coach position ranges from Rs. 350 to Rs. 700 per hour, depending on the specific discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Guest Coach posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma or Certificate course in coaching from a recognized institution, or professional coaching experience, or participation at a national/state/inter-college level in their discipline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Guest Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Which sports disciplines have vacancies for Guest Coaches?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available for Athletics, Badminton, Basketball, Chess, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Lawn Tennis, Table Tennis, and Volleyball.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Guest Coach positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and a Practical Field Test.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the NIT Jamshedpur office in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand.
